Name: Memory Arrest
Components: V, M (A drop of blood and a vial of snake venom)
Description:
You attempt to obscure a single memory from a creature you can see within range. Creatures that can’t be charmed are immune to this effect. This spell targets a specific memory and makes it inaccessible to the creature for the duration, but it cannot erase general knowledge or innate understanding; for example: you can make it forget a name it has only heard once, but you cannot make it forget that a knife can cut, as that is broad knowledge.

The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you can choose a memory that they might have and make it inaccessible for the duration of the spell. The target will not be able to remember the specified memory, and won’t naturally believe anyone that tries to remind them. If someone tries to make them remember by telling them what happened, the target must make an Intelligence (History) check against your spell save DC or not believe what the other creature is telling them.

If you or any of your companions damage the target, the spell ends. This spell does not reveal any memories of the target to you, you must choose a memory that you know the target has, otherwise the spell will fail.
